## Battery Smart Revenue Rises 43.8% in FY26

Battery Smart reported strong revenue growth in FY26, while its annual loss narrowed, according to the company’s regulatory filings.

Revenue increased 43.8% year-on-year to ₹358 crore in FY26, compared with ₹249 crore in FY25. Meanwhile, its loss narrowed 12.8% year-on-year to ₹23.55 crore.

The financial performance indicates that the company expanded its revenue base while reducing its reported losses. The combination of growth and narrowing losses will be important as Battery Smart continues to invest in network expansion and infrastructure. [...] Prince Mishra

Battery-swapping startup Battery Smart has raised approximately ₹98 crore from existing investor Ecosystem Integrity Fund as it looks to expand its network for electric two- and three-wheelers. The fresh capital will support business expansion, capital expenditure and working capital requirements as the Gurugram-based company continues to scale its battery-swapping infrastructure. [...] The latest fundraising could provide additional resources to support this expansion, although the company’s future financial performance will depend on its ability to manage capital expenditure, improve operational efficiency and grow usage across its network.

## Outlook for Battery Smart

Battery Smart’s latest ₹98 crore investment highlights continued investor support for its battery-swapping business as electric mobility adoption creates opportunities for supporting infrastructure providers.

With a post-money valuation estimated at around ₹4,170 crore, more than $221 million raised to date and revenue of ₹358 crore in FY26, the company is working to scale its presence in the electric two- and three-wheeler segments.

results.content:
🔋 Battery Smart Raises $19.5 Million at $430 Million Valuation as EV Battery-Swapping Network Expands
India’s EV battery-swapping startup Battery Smart has raised $19.5 million (₹185.5 crore) in Series C funding, led by existing investor @Rising Tide Ventures, with participation from Ecosystem Integrity Fund and Blume Ventures.
The latest round reportedly values the company at around $430 million, taking its total funding raised to more than $211 million.
🔹 What Is Battery Smart Building?
Battery Smart operates a battery-swapping network for electric two- and three-wheelers, allowing drivers to replace depleted batteries in minutes instead of waiting for conventional charging. [...] Battery Smart’s challenge now is to scale its network fast enough while maintaining battery availability, asset utilisation and unit economics across a capital-intensive infrastructure business.
Can Battery Smart turn battery swapping into one of India’s dominant EV infrastructure models?
Follow CEO Review for more updates on EVs, startups, funding, mobility and business growth.
#BatterySmart #EV #BatterySwapping #ElectricVehicles #EVIndia #StartupFunding #Funding #Investment #IndianStartups #Mobility [...] The model is particularly relevant for commercial EV users, where vehicle downtime can directly impact daily earnings.
🔹 Growth Is Picking Up
According to investor disclosures, the company’s FY26 revenue reportedly reached ₹358 crore, representing growth of 43.8% year-on-year.
The fresh capital will be used to expand its swapping network further and strengthen its underlying technology infrastructure.
🔹 Why It Matters
As India’s electric mobility ecosystem grows, battery swapping is emerging as an alternative infrastructure model for high-utilisation vehicles such as e-rickshaws, delivery fleets and other commercial EVs.
